requiredCases: fixed-seed no-offload versus single-stream versus streams-mode forward parity
fixed-seed gradient parity across the same three modes
two autograd-saved views sharing a storage with mode-specific deduplication behavior
FSDP2 on available accelerator hardware or explicit UNAVAILABLE evidence
acceptance: Bind each exact upstream source and the exact TRL package/source artifact actually executed; moving main is not equivalent.
Correctness gates require matched outputs and gradients against a no-offload baseline before performance can be interpreted.
Single-stream shared-storage views must not inherit streams-mode deduplication semantics.
The evaluator must prove live-current-stream behavior on a non-default compute stream rather than only exercising the default stream.
Nonzero storage offsets and noncontiguous views must reconstruct in bounds with correct values and gradients.
Unsupported FSDP2 or accelerator configurations are recorded as UNAVAILABLE and are never simulated as passing.
Preserve rollback to the currently admitted exact TRL stack and keep production training routes/defaults unchanged.
Project only admitted exact-source evidence through Hugging Face, a-11-oy.com and a11oy.net.

steps: Implement the deterministic evaluation lane in szl-forge issue #324 without widening production dependencies.

Record exact source/package, Python, Torch, CUDA or accelerator runtime, driver and device identities in the evidence bundle.
Fail closed on any output mismatch, gradient mismatch, out-of-bounds view reconstruction, stale stream ordering, missing hardware identity or ambiguous source revision.
After normal merge controls, return sealed evidence to Frontier #153; do not publish a product/runtime capability or change a training default from evaluation-only evidence.
